no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Optimi Health is a Health-Canada-licensed commercial-stage GMP manufacturer of natural psilocybin and MDMA, supplying clinical trials and special-access programs operated by third parties. The company itself does not sponsor any P1/P2/P3 clinical trials (CT.gov shows zero qualifying records as sponsor). Reported activity is supply for Australia's Authorised Prescriber Scheme (TRD treatment with 5 mg natural psilocybin capsules), supply for upcoming third-party Phase 2 trials in Canada and abroad, and a newly launched Ibogaine manufacturing initiative (April 2026). No proprietary clinical-stage drug candidate is in active P1/P2/P3 development under Optimi as sponsor.
